confidence_notes: Holistic estimates based on Philippine provincial prices and Siargao’s surf-tourism market. July lodging prices and registered-property categories are uncertain; cocktail and wine estimates are based on their typical price premium over domestic beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used a tourist-oriented Philippine island market as the basis, combining provincial Philippine food prices with the higher dining and lodging costs typical of a surf destination such as Siargao’s General Luna.
